v6.25.2.edition: M10 origination fallback, freshness bar-identity fix
v6.25.2.compiler_result: 0 errors, 0 warnings (MetaEditor64.exe, isolated sandbox + Mac live install + VPS, all three hash-identical)
v6.25.2.release_notes: M10 can now originate its own qualifying trade candidate when ScoreSetups proposes nothing or a stale/mismatched direction, instead of only vetoing. Fixed M10 freshness classification (bar-identity based, not raw elapsed seconds).

v6.25.3.compiler_result: 0 errors, 0 warnings (MetaEditor64.exe, isolated sandbox only -- NOT YET verified on the owner's Mac live install or VPS; do not treat as hash-confirmed across all three until that verification happens)
v6.25.3.release_notes: LogTradeToServer() now reports rich per-trade data at close (broker ticket, entry/exit price and time, commission, swap, original risk USD, final R, MAE/MFE in R, campaign ID, EA version, account login, exit reason, exit owner, trade family) to a new additive /api/journal/log schema. Backend GET /api/cloud/performance/analytics computes real win rate, profit factor, average R, drawdown, and a real cumulative equity curve from this data, replacing the Command Center's synthetic 5-point interpolated equity curve. Older EA installs posting the pre-v6.25.3 thin payload continue to work unchanged; their trades are excluded from analytics (no fabricated risk/R data) rather than breaking ingestion.
